svg.title: AI-Human OS node-contract flow diagram
svg.desc: Every layer shown as a node-to-contract-to-node chain from Init through Metrics. Human nodes are coral, LLM nodes are purple, deterministic nodes are teal. Contract artifacts sit between nodes as gray labels.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Init layer')
sendPrompt('What does the deterministic code do in the Init layer?')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the intent intake layer')
sendPrompt('What does the LLM do during planning intake?')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the planning ladder')
sendPrompt('What does the planning compiler do?')
sendPrompt('When does the behavior simulation layer run?')
sendPrompt('What are the four behavior simulation stages?')
sendPrompt('What happens if the simulation report fails?')
sendPrompt('What does the operator layer do?')
sendPrompt('What constraints does the execute agent receive?')
sendPrompt('What does the verification layer check?')
sendPrompt('What is Gate 3 and what is the content hash binding?')
sendPrompt('What does the acceptance layer do and why is it the only layer that makes state real?')
sendPrompt('What triggers the next execution cycle?')
sendPrompt('What metrics does the system emit per cycle and per run?')
sendPrompt('What does the throughput policy control?')

svg.text: Human defines what should mean something.
LLM drafts what that meaning might look like as artifacts.
Deterministic code decides what is allowed to become real.
Human intent → Gate 1 → planning ladder → compile → Gate 2
→ behavior sim (conditional) → typed request → one file → verify → Gate 3 → acceptance → metrics
